_readme: Each entry is one device. type: 'feed' (RSS/Atom), 'html' (regex over a page), 'browser' (same as html but the page is rendered by headless Chromium first — for JS-only sites), or 'manual' (catalog placeholder, not tracked yet). item_match filters feed items by title. version_regex must have one capture group. Categories: R routers, N NAS, S smart home, C consoles/drones/e-bikes, M makers/open firmware. Optional: skip_match (regex of titles to ignore, default skips rc/beta/alpha), date_regex (html only, one capture group). type 'github' uses the GitHub API latest-release endpoint (stable only): set repo: 'owner/name'. Optional html fields: notes_regex (one group, DOTALL), page_url (human link to show instead of the fetched url). Optional browser fields: wait_for (CSS selector), click (CSS selector), wait_ms. In date_regex/notes_regex, the literal token {version} is replaced with the matched version so they anchor to the right entry.
